required_meaning.component_promoted: NONE -- no receiving conversion component is promoted
required_meaning.information_ceiling_note: NO CEILING IS DECLARED. A four-rung ladder on already-authorized inputs cannot establish one. What is established is that the conversion signal reachable from CURRENTLY HELD inputs is small.
required_meaning.current_input_signal: WEAK -- the closed ladder recovered 4.89% of the measured conversion oracle opportunity, worth 0.96% of baseline CRPS
required_meaning.future_priority: New INFORMATION, not another broad same-input estimator ladder. The honest next question is which information, not which estimator.
required_meaning.composition_mandatory: Composition into the downstream outcome distribution remains MANDATORY for every future component evaluation. A primitive-only result is not a result.

methodological_lesson_PRESERVED.statement: PRIMITIVE-LEVEL RANKINGS CAN REVERSE AFTER COMPOSITION.

measured_evidence.reading: C is roughly fourteen times the better primitive and contributes half as much downstream.

methodological_lesson_PRESERVED.mechanism: Y = T x C x V. An error in V multiplies across every reception; an error in C moves the reception count by a fraction of one catch. A primitive metric measures the estimate; only composition measures what the estimate does.
methodological_lesson_PRESERVED.related_prior_finding: R1 found the same failure in the harmful direction -- a better isolated primitive worsening the composed simulator.
methodological_lesson_PRESERVED.binding_consequence: Any future work that ranks candidates on primitive metrics alone will get the research priority backwards. Ranking on primitive metrics alone is therefore not an acceptable basis for a priority claim in this project.

measured_results_NOT_TO_BE_REWRITTEN.identity_arm_E: reproduces every realised Y exactly; max |err| 1.4e-14 to 2.8e-14, draw spread exactly 0.0
measured_results_NOT_TO_BE_REWRITTEN.sample_label: EXPLORATORY -- heavily mined development data, never confirmatory

known_baseline_defects_carried_forward.reading: over-predicts, and intervals are too wide at every nominal level
known_baseline_defects_carried_forward.why_not_fixed_in_RC1: Repairing the baseline after seeing the decomposition is the result-driven change the RC1 pre-registration section 11 forbids.

what_this_decision_does_NOT_do: It does NOT promote any receiving conversion component.
It does NOT declare an information ceiling.
It does NOT alter ABC_MPR, which stays a frozen prospective candidate, not promoted.
It does NOT alter Stage 2 ewma_hl2 as the accepted participation model.
It does NOT change G0A, which remains 11/12.
It does NOT authorize NFL-1, which remains NOT AUTHORIZED.
